Cedar Office Services looks after the shared printer. The model number is on the inside of the front cover. The small toner box on the shelf is the spare, not an outstanding order.

Alex here. The amounts in [expenses.csv](/workspace/finance/expenses.csv) are in euros and include tax. EXP-041 is document storage, EXP-042 is the team coordination meeting, and EXP-043 is stationery.
